what: The plan changes rebase_and_rebump to pass base_remote/base_ref into apply_bump but does not update existing monkeypatched apply_bump stubs that only accept cwd.
scenario_or_breakage: make py-test will fail with TypeError in existing rebase tests once the planned unconditional keyword arguments are added.
suggested_fix: Include the two existing test stubs in python/test_rebase.py in the test update scope and let them accept base_remote/base_ref or **kwargs.
